company.name: in-tech GmbH
company.tagline: Moving the future! We make everyday life smart, simple, sustainable and safe.
company.description:
We create the mobility of the future: in-tech develops innovative solutions for Automotive, Smart City and Smart Factory. With our innovative products and services, we make everyday life intelligent, simple, sustainable and safe.

We make the car of the future autonomous, electric and connected. We develop solutions for intelligent mobility in cities - such as services for car sharing, bike sharing or other smart functions. And with our Industry 4.0 solutions, we provide integration in the Smart Factory.

*** What we do***

Automotive Electronics: We are working on making the car of the future autonomous, electric and connected. As a strategic development partner, we support our customers throughout the entire product development process: from development to system integration to after sales.  

Electrified: The future of mobility is electric - we also deal with the challenges for infrastructure providers, municipalities and fleet operators. With the e-troFit concept, we offer retrofit solutions for existing vehicles and thus enable a rapid transition to electromobility. We also offer solutions for the charging infrastructure in charging stations and vehicles.

Smart Factory: More efficiency, transparency and productivity in your machinery - we implement individual industry 4.0 solutions for machine builders and plant operators. 

***Who we are***

in-tech was founded in 2002 and has been consistently growing ever since. We currently employ more than 2000 people at locations in 9 countries. We place great value on a family-like atmosphere and a friendly, open working environment. We have already received several awards for excellent working atmosphere, team spirit and work-life balance.
